_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff Valinor v3.2.71

Retains the Max 80 through Max 220 gauge menu and its GUI/standalone control profile. Shared fixes include truthful incomplete/rejected SysID results, steady seven-phase progress, acquisition-frame recovery proof, plot controls above the first plot after resizing, one-row navigation and clear RUN states.

OLED header/progress boxes are rounded; the GUI mirrors the actual device framebuffer. Firmware rev27v-gauge-35 changes display rendering only; safety thresholds and gauge control parameters are unchanged. Live NI BPF matches offline zero-phase morphology with an explicit approximately 8.2-second delay. Pulse-envelope/tracking diagnostics and calibration readback/history remain included.

The installer includes complete app-local Python and Arduino runtime. Receiving PCs need no Python, Git, pip, winget or Arduino installation; NI-DAQmx remains an optional separately installed driver. Updates verify exact branch asset URL, size and SHA-256, wait for fresh idle/pump-off/vented telemetry and use protected calibration-preserving firmware alignment.

Shared SysID/isolation/safety/display tests, layout audit and smoke checks passed. Firmware gauge35 was protected-flashed with verified calibration/FF/K/PID restore, then completed the ten-minute seed-213 soak: 8/8 scored cycles, HARD-GATE PASS, 29,503/29,503 frames (100% delivery), no gaps over 0.16 s and OLED liveness PASS. Achieved deflation averaged 2.415 mmHg/s against the retained 3 mmHg/s target; this is not perfect slope tracking. Two-cuff generalization and 1000-device yield remain unvalidated. Rejected or synthesized SysID cannot replace a known-good profile. Accepted calibration sharing requires individual Issues-only enrollment and maintainer-reviewed application releases; old local profiles remain recoverable.


Final SysID provenance correction: cross-band and missing-band gain replacements are recorded as synthesized, with raw fits preserved. Final acceptance runs after all replacements and rejects synthesized gains or argmax open boundaries. The GUI shows diagnostic versus replacement values separately and cannot offer rejected PID or replace the known-good snapshot.

Larger-cuff109 completed all seven phases, but LOW raw K approximately0.124 was replaced by MID0.713 and LOW never crossed the open threshold. Its corrected verdict is SUSPECT. Original archive, native NI/serial and corrected replay are retained; no profile was adopted. This result does not establish cuff transfer or manufacturing yield.

Valinor SysID retains a consistent3 mmHg/s fitting/feedforward/persistence target, matching its Max profile.
